dashboard.welcome: A quick walkthrough of the essentials. You can skip anytime.
dashboard.create: Create an auction in under a minute from here: name, description and end date.
dashboard.quota: Each auction shows its used lots, people and photos. The red badge marks finished ones.
dashboard.myAuctions: Auctions you created. The trash icon on the top right deletes them with confirmation.
dashboard.bids: Track your active bids here and whether you're winning or outbid.

create.welcome: Only the name is required. The end date defaults to 30 days.
create.name: A clear name sells better: what is auctioned and for whom.
create.endDate: Optional. Left as is, it closes in 30 days. It can never exceed that cap.
create.itemEndMode: Choose whether your lots end with the auction, on a custom date, or never.
create.submit: Create the auction, then add items from its page.

item.welcome: This is an item at auction. Here's where to bid and follow along.
item.bid: Enter your amount above the minimum and confirm. Bids are binding: they can't be retracted.
item.history: All bids in order, highest highlighted. The yellow badge marks new accounts.
item.fulfillment: Once closed with a winner, payment and delivery are coordinated here, and both sides can rate each other.
item.discussions: Ask the owner or chat with other members. They lock once the item ends.
